case.task_description: Roll back the billing-worker deployment tied to the open incident.
case.why: Only one candidate exists and it is genuinely never rollback-eligible while the incident stays open. Tests that Reflexion returns the best-scoring (not a fabricated-successful) attempt after exhausting max_trials — an honest negative result, matching this repo's existing mini_suite convention of reporting real findings rather than smoothing them over.

trials.reflection: I picked deployment #1 (status 'Failed') without checking whether its status allows a rollback. External feedback: Deployment #1 is 'Failed'; only a Succeeded or InProgress deployment can be rolled back.. Next trial, I should only propose a deployment whose status is Succeeded or InProgress.
